positive_rule: Primary Pareto arm with >=.1pp key gain, each key decline<=.2pp and Short4 decline<=.15pp
gradient_protocol: Unchanged eight first seed0 epoch0 frozen global1024 batches at step500; raw per-view native-backbone CE gradients all-reduce/4; no optimizer updates
KR234_rng: Separate private K RNG SHA256(seed:epoch:sample_id:nested_detail_kr234_k_v1); subset RNG retains original nested_detail_d3_v1 namespace, so K3 choices match anchor
source_policy: All launched sources/configs and CPU test receipt archived in Git before training; unchanged through seven arms
stop_policy: Actual local read failure,CUDA/OOM,DDP/NCCL,nonfinite,oom_kill,step>60s,supervisor/pod failure; ordinary >3s warnings continue
